capabilities.name: Implementation & Dependency Economy
capabilities.purpose: Minimize code volume, state, wrappers, and dependencies via the 6-step decision ladder.
conflicts: Never overrides correctness, accessibility, or security.
verification_requirements: Zero unrequested dependencies, dead code, or redundant wrappers.

capabilities.name: Task Classification, Routing & Progressive Context
capabilities.purpose: Classify 5 task dimensions and load only task-matched references within experimental token budgets.
conflicts: Expand context when concrete gaps or verification failures appear.
verification_requirements: Only relevant references loaded; zero nonexistent reference paths.

capabilities.name: Adaptive Execution Modes & Risk Scaling
capabilities.purpose: Select QUICK, STANDARD, PREMIUM, or FLAGSHIP based on scope and risk, with user override and escalation.
conflicts: Explicit user mode override wins.
verification_requirements: Trivial edits use QUICK; high-risk edits trigger stronger verification.

capabilities.name: Project, Framework & Dependency Awareness
capabilities.purpose: Detect and preserve existing framework, styling, tooling, and dependencies without unrequested migrations.
conflicts: Explicit user migration request overrides preservation.
verification_requirements: Idiomatic code matching existing stack; builds cleanly.

capabilities.name: Lightweight Persistent Design Memory
capabilities.purpose: Preserve non-obvious cross-session design decisions without duplicating authoritative code tokens.
conflicts: Authoritative project code and explicit user changes override stale memory.
verification_requirements: No duplicate code/secrets stored; stale records updated on conflict.

capabilities.name: Existing Component Discovery & Reuse
capabilities.purpose: Discover and reuse existing UI primitives before creating new components.
conflicts: Existing component APIs preserved unless user requests redesign.
verification_requirements: Zero duplicate primitives when suitable components exist.

capabilities.name: Risk-Based Functional & Regression Verification
capabilities.purpose: Run targeted or regression checks scaled to risk and report exact observed results.
conflicts: Never skip mandatory functional/a11y/security gates for tool economy.
verification_requirements: Checks executed after final edit; honest reporting of unverified items.

capabilities.name: Bounded Refinement, Stopping & Graceful Degradation
capabilities.purpose: Fix concrete defects within mode budgets, stop when criteria pass, and degrade honestly when tools are missing.
conflicts: Never ship broken critical behavior merely because a pass budget expired.
verification_requirements: Each refinement targets a real defect; unavailable tools reported honestly.

capabilities.name: Product-Grounded Creative Direction
capabilities.purpose: Derive visual direction, adaptive aesthetics, and optional multi-concept exploration from the product brief.
conflicts: Existing design system wins unless redesign is requested.
verification_requirements: Visual choices trace to product subject, audience, and primary job.

capabilities.name: Contextual Anti-Generic Judgment & Critique
capabilities.purpose: Detect clichéd AI UI defaults contextually and run preliminary design critique without rigid universal bans.
conflicts: Explicit user aesthetic requests override anti-generic heuristics.
verification_requirements: No unmotivated filler badges, fake stats, or cloned card kits.

capabilities.name: Focal Restraint & Composition Hierarchy
capabilities.purpose: Focus boldness in one primary focal element while keeping supporting chrome disciplined.
conflicts: Adapt density for operational dashboards via FF-SP-01.
verification_requirements: Clear single focal point above the fold.

capabilities.name: Unified Typography Engine
capabilities.purpose: Combine font pairing, responsive type scale, measure limits, and webfont performance.
conflicts: Display font expression vs. CLS/bundle budget.
verification_requirements: Clear hierarchy, readable measure, zero font-load layout shift.

capabilities.name: Semantic & Accessible Color System
capabilities.purpose: Pair cohesive color palettes with semantic roles, WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, and surface/materiality discipline.
conflicts: Brand accent colors vs. WCAG contrast; accessibility wins.
verification_requirements: Text contrast >= 4.5:1 (3:1 large text/UI).

capabilities.name: Layout Grid, Alignment & Responsive Strategy
capabilities.purpose: Build content-driven CSS Grid/Flexbox layouts with zero horizontal overflow across viewports.
conflicts: Asymmetric desktop layouts vs. mobile readability.
verification_requirements: Zero horizontal overflow from 320px to 1440px+.

capabilities.name: Adaptive Density, Materiality & Asset Direction
capabilities.purpose: Calibrate whitespace, elevation, iconography consistency, and media framing to the product.
conflicts: High density vs. >=44px touch targets on mobile.
verification_requirements: Density fits task frequency; consistent icons and honest asset usage.

capabilities.name: Information Architecture & Task Navigation
capabilities.purpose: Structure navigation and hierarchy around user tasks and clear signposting.
conflicts: Minimalist nav hiding vs. primary task discoverability.
verification_requirements: Primary tasks discoverable with consistent terminology.

capabilities.name: Interface Microcopy & Action Clarity
capabilities.purpose: Write active, user-centric labels, CTAs, and error copy without marketing filler.
conflicts: Playful voice vs. transactional clarity; clarity wins.
verification_requirements: Active outcome verbs on CTAs; zero fake stats.

capabilities.name: Resilient UI States & Error Recovery
capabilities.purpose: Cover loading, empty, error, partial, and success states for interactive flows.
conflicts: Minimal diff vs. async error handling; correctness wins.
verification_requirements: All async states handled with actionable recovery.

capabilities.name: Form Usability & Mobile Ergonomics
capabilities.purpose: Ensure visible labels, inline validation, input types, and >=44px touch ergonomics.
conflicts: Compact layout vs. visible labels; accessibility wins.
verification_requirements: Programmatic labels and touch-friendly targets.

capabilities.name: Tokenized Design System & Theme Parity
capabilities.purpose: Define semantic tokens for color, type, spacing, and verified light/dark themes.
conflicts: Token granularity vs. economy; keep tokens minimal and semantic.
verification_requirements: Consistent semantic tokens; contrast passes in all themes.

capabilities.name: Unified Motion & Interaction Intelligence
capabilities.purpose: Apply purposeful, interruptible, GPU-composited motion, springs, micro-interactions, gestures, and reduced-motion compliance.
conflicts: Motion richness vs. vestibular accessibility; reduced-motion always wins.
verification_requirements: Purposeful motion only; interruptible; honors prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

capabilities.name: Product-Domain & AI-Native Ergonomics
capabilities.purpose: Adapt density, trust cues, mobile-first viewports, and AI streaming/provenance patterns by product domain.
conflicts: Minimalism vs. domain trust/compliance cues; clarity wins.
verification_requirements: Layout density and patterns fit the target product category.

capabilities.name: Accessible Interactive Primitives
capabilities.purpose: Enforce keyboard operability, focus management, and ARIA semantics on interactive controls.
conflicts: Custom styling vs. native semantics; never replace buttons with divs.
verification_requirements: 100% keyboard operable with visible focus and Escape handling.

capabilities.name: Semantic HTML, Modern CSS & Safe Rendering
capabilities.purpose: Enforce landmark/heading semantics, low-specificity CSS, responsive sizing, and XSS/link-safety hygiene.
conflicts: Safety and semantics override decorative shortcuts.
verification_requirements: Valid landmarks, clean CSS specificity, zero unsanitized HTML injection.

capabilities.name: Frontend Performance & Bundle Discipline
capabilities.purpose: Optimize Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP), asset/font loading, data viz, and JS bundle footprint.
conflicts: Rich widgets vs. bundle weight; lazy-load non-critical code.
verification_requirements: Reserved media dimensions; no heavy unrequested packages.

capabilities.name: Rendered Visual, Functional & Accessibility Audit
capabilities.purpose: Inspect live rendered output, user journeys, keyboard/WCAG gates, motion/perf, and engineering waste.
conflicts: Degrade honestly via FF-VF-04 if browser tools are unavailable.
verification_requirements: No visual verification claimed without rendered inspection.

capabilities.name: Universal Aesthetic Ban-Lists
capabilities.purpose: Rigid blanket bans on gradients, cards, rounded corners, or centered layouts.
conflicts: Contradicts explicit user briefs and contextual judgment.
verification_requirements: Excluded from FORMFORGE.

capabilities.name: Static Preset Theme Gallery
capabilities.purpose: Bundling fixed named theme presets as default styling.
conflicts: Encourages generic template picking over domain grounding.
verification_requirements: Excluded from FORMFORGE.

capabilities.name: Speculative Custom CLI & Knowledge Graph Runtime
capabilities.purpose: Custom runtime engine, database, or knowledge graph for skill orchestration.
conflicts: Violates architectural economy and cross-agent portability.
verification_requirements: Zero speculative runtime infrastructure.

capabilities.name: Automated Multi-Model Visual Judge & Motion Telemetry
capabilities.purpose: Automated headless browser screenshot scoring and frame-drop telemetry pipeline.
conflicts: Premature before Phase 04 engineering and baseline runs.
verification_requirements: Deferred to Phase 05.
